entities.summary: Jennifer Janiska is a German professional volleyball player. She was the captain of the Germany women's national volleyball team who won the silver medal at the 2013 European Championships with the national team. At club level, Janiska won the world title with Imoco Volley Conegliano in 2019. She currently plays in the United States of for LOVB Madison of the LOVB Pro league.
